hero.lead: Loqelo is a new platform that connects you with local service providers for your home, garden and office. Describe what you need in your own words, receive offers and choose who does the job.

intro.title: One place for all the work your place needs.
intro.body: From a dripping tap to a garden makeover, Loqelo will bring together people who need a job done and the local professionals who do it. One simple request replaces endless searching, calling and comparing.

items.a: Loqelo is planned to launch in February 2027. Everyone on the waitlist will receive an email when it opens.

items.q: What happens when I join the waitlist?
items.a: You'll receive launch announcements and occasional project updates by email. There's no obligation, and you can unsubscribe at any time with one click.
Yes. Joining the waitlist is completely free.
Services for the home, garden and office — from cleaning and repairs to gardening, installations and moving. The full list of categories will be announced before launch.

items.q: Which countries will Loqelo be available in?
items.a: We're collecting interest from customers and service providers in many countries. Launch locations will be announced before launch.

items.q: I'm a service provider. Can I sign up now?
items.a: Yes. Choose ‘I provide services’ in the form and select the country where you work. We'll send you updates for providers ahead of the launch.

privacy.draft: Draft for review — the client must approve this text and add the company details before go-live.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: This website is operated by Loqelo (“we”, “us”). The controller responsible for your data is: {controller}.

sections.heading: What we collect when you join the waitlist
paragraphs: Your email address; the country you selected; whether you joined as a customer or as a service provider; whether you are an individual or a business (only if you chose to tell us); the language of the page; and the date, time and version of the consent text you accepted.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: To send you launch announcements and project updates about Loqelo, which you asked for. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). We also look at aggregated numbers — for example, sign-ups per country — to plan the launch.

sections.heading: Service providers we use
paragraphs: Waitlist contacts are stored in Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France), our email and contact management provider. The website is hosted by Vercel Inc. Cloudflare Turnstile protects the forms against spam. Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.) is used only if you accept analytics. Each provider processes data on our behalf under a data processing agreement.

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
paragraphs: Google Analytics is only loaded after you accept it. It uses cookies to count visits and shows us the approximate country of visitors. Advertising features and Google signals are switched off. We never send your email address or form answers to Google Analytics.

We also store your language choice and your analytics choice in your browser so the site works as you expect. You can change your analytics choice at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page.

sections.heading: How long we keep your data
paragraphs: Until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it, or until the waitlist is no longer needed after the launch — whichever comes first.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, correct, export or delete your data, and withdraw your consent at any time — every email contains an unsubscribe link. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.
